paper_statement: On angled-step geometries, Transolver predictions cease to be meaningful beyond 20 degrees while Geo-NeW remains meaningful through the tested 30-degree range.
source_anchor: main.tex, Figure 1 caption, Section 4.4, and Figure 6
assumptions: The paper's custom NS2d-c++ angled-step generator, PDE solves, split, and evaluation grid are used.
The paper's trained Transolver and Geo-NeW models or faithful training pipelines are used.
All tested step angles through 30 degrees are evaluated.

acceptance.verified: A preregistered angle sweep on the paper distribution confirms the comparative behavior using an explicit failure criterion tied to the paper evaluation.
acceptance.falsified: A faithful angle sweep contradicts the quantified range comparison.

required_inputs: custom NS2d-c++ angled-step data/generator and reference PDE solutions
trained Transolver and Geo-NeW checkpoints or complete training pipelines
an operational definition of the paper's qualitative phrase 'cease to be meaningful'
rejection_rule: A hand-drawn step, forward-pass smoke test, source figure inspection, or arbitrary failure threshold cannot decide the claim.
